title: T-pillar at Çavuştepe, visited with Robert Schoch

tellings.quote: that shavo Tepe it's made out of balt now now that's Robert shock right there uh we were all there just recently

plain: At Çavuştepe in Turkey there is a T-shaped stone pillar made of basalt, of the kind found at very old sites in the region. Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient sites, says he went there recently with a group that included Robert Schoch, a geologist who studies ancient monuments, and he shows a picture of Schoch standing by the stone. He brings it up as part of his case that a lost early civilisation once existed.
